description: Add a screen, slide, page or post (preset sizes it). What a control opens (dropdown, filter, menu) is add_hidden_ui.

preset.description: A page size by name: slide_16x9 (1920 x 1080), slide_4x3, a4_portrait, a4_landscape, letter, letter_landscape, poster_a3, poster_18x24, ig_feed (1080 x 1350), ig_square, ig_story (1080 x 1920), x_post, linkedin, youtube_thumb. In place of width and height.

tone.description: base, inverse (a dark page) or accent (a page in the accent colour), in the project's own palette: a deck's rhythm of light, dark and colour slides.
